description: Land Acquisition - Kalegala, Nuwara Eliya D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister that specific land (described by lot, extent, boundaries, and location) is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazette category (Type 4) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
